name: Cream of Lettuce Soup
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: cold boiled onion, minced fine
ingredients.originalText: 1 tablespoonful of cold boiled onion, minced fine

instructions.text: Shred finely two heads of lettuce — the greener the better.
Cook for half an hour in a quart of good stock, rub through a colander.
Return to the fire; stir into a cup of this two tablespoonfuls of white roux and a tablespoonful of cold boiled onion, minced fine, and one of minced parsley.
Heat a cup of milk in another vessel, season with pepper and salt, stir in a well-whipped egg, and pour this mixture into the tureen, adding finally the lettuce soup.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Shred finely two heads of lettuce — the greener the better.
2. Cook for half an hour in a quart of good stock, rub through a colander.
3. Return to the fire; stir into a cup of this two tablespoonfuls of white roux and a tablespoonful of cold boiled onion, minced fine, and one of minced parsley.
4. Heat a cup of milk in another vessel, season with pepper and salt, stir in a well-whipped egg, and pour this mixture into the tureen, adding finally the lettuce soup.
